normal:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single production-ready fantasy game UI button sprite, NORMAL/IDLE STATE, without any text, isolated on true transparent alpha.
Design family: Dream&Nightmare title screen, a painterly midnight-blue misty village, antique silver serif logo, icy crescent moon and restrained crimson nightmare reflection. Button should be much simpler than the ornate logo.
Canvas: wide landscape 1536 x 512 pixels, or exact 3:1 equivalent. One horizontal button centered. Visible plate approximately x=120..1416, y=140..372, a long 5.6:1 rectangle with small clipped/chamfered corners. Modest silver endcaps may reach x=88 and x=1448. The button plus delicate close shadow must remain fully inside the frame. Transparent generous margins on all sides, no cropping.
Button: flat front-facing symmetrical horizontal navy-blue panel, subtly translucent deep midnight enamel with faint painterly fog-like grain; enough dark fill for ivory Korean text to be overlaid later. Fine aged SILVER double hairline perimeter, narrow tasteful bevel, shallow subdued brushed metal terminal details at each end. Center 75 percent is smooth EMPTY clear text space, no emblem or pattern there. Small simple angular silver accents only at the far ends, no giant ornaments, no large diamond in the middle. Normal state subdued, thin neutral silver border, only extremely faint blue tint. Sophisticated, quiet, readable, delicate, no chunky fantasy stone or wooden plaque. The button should work displayed around 380 x 68 pixels.
Transparency: actual transparent canvas OUTSIDE the plate; do not draw a black rectangle, mockup background, checkerboard, or a backdrop. Interior panel is dark navy, not transparent empty hole. Any shadow is local, tight and alpha blended.
No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logo, no glyphs, no crescent or selection icon attached to the button, no cursor, no stacked variants, no contact sheet, no surrounding UI, no watermark. Exactly ONE blank normal button.
hover:

Preserve the exact original 2172x724 canvas, aspect ratio, button position, dimensions, silhouette, corner cuts, two end ornaments, metal texture, border thickness and empty center. Do not redesign, move, resize or crop the button.
Change ONLY its illumination: brighten the existing fine silver perimeter with a restrained icy pale BLUE glow concentrated just inside the rim, slightly brighten the navy enamel with blue reflected light. Keep the center sufficiently dark for ivory text added later. Subtle premium fantasy UI highlight, not neon, no broad luminous fog. This is the same panel lit up on selection, not a different panel. No text, no icons, no cursor, no new ornaments.
Preserve real alpha transparency outside the existing button, including all margins and counters. Output one image only.

LOCK original 2172x724 image dimensions, transparent margins, silhouette, centered position, chamfered corners, exact border geometry, two small diamond endcaps and center texture. disabled: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the normal Dream&Nightmare title button EDIT TARGET. Produce its DISABLED / UNAVAILABLE appearance. Preserve image dimensions 2172x724, all transparent margins, original button silhouette, placement, long chamfered shape, fine border and two angular silver endcaps. Genuine alpha transparency outside the plate, no background. Exactly one blank button.

selectionDiamond:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE tiny game-menu selection indicator, separate sprite on true transparent alpha, for Dream&Nightmare.
Create a single elegant upright slender DIAMOND / four-point lozenge, antique silver outline and luminous icy pale blue inset, a small brighter pale silver core. Match a refined painterly dark-fantasy menu button with navy enamel, fine weathered silver double-line edges and tiny diamond endcaps. Clean crisp silhouette readable at 18 to 24 pixels tall, simple geometry with a little engraved metal depth. Tasteful modest local blue halo, never a huge glow. The diamond is vertical, about twice as tall as wide, centered in a square 512x512 canvas occupying middle 45 percent of height, generous transparent padding. Slightly faceted blue glass, subtle weathered silver. This is a functional selection marker beside a menu row, not jewelry, not a medallion, not a complex rune.
NO text, no letters, no additional glyphs, no button, no backing plate, no background rectangle, no checkerboard, no scene, no multiple designs, no watermark. Exactly one isolated marker with genuine alpha around it.
